fact: The Annuaire statistique national 2023 (INSD, December 2024) compiles statistics from ministry administrative sources: DGESS education ministries (MEBAPLN, MESFPT, MESRSI school returns), health ministry (DGESS/MS health yearbook), MATDS civil registration (births, marriages, deaths by commune), justice (courts and prisons), police and gendarmerie records, transport, and external trade (customs).
title: Annuaire statistique national 2023
publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
